latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Grok.

- Generate AI-powered videos from text prompts or uploaded documents, with no video editing required.
- Supports file uploads (TXT, DOCX, PDF, RTF; up to 500MB) and produces downloadable 1080p MP4 output.
- Automatic cloud setup: handles token generation, session management, and secure export with user feedback at each step.
- Includes handling for credits, progress, upload, export, and common errors, all surfaced via simple commands.
- Designed for fast, streamlined video creation workflows — ideal for creators wanting quick results without technical setup.
